source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nuclear fission (PDF 140-143).

blocks.text: Germany ke Otto Hahn aur Fritz Strassmann ne aik hairan-kun daryaft ki: jab dheemi raftar ke neutrons uranium-235 par barsaye jayein to reaction se barium-141 aur krypton-92 aur ausatan teen neutrons bante hain. Barium aur krypton dono ki kamiyat uranium se kam hai. Yeh reaction doosre nuclear reactions se do tarah mukhtalif tha: uranium nucleus taqreeban barabar size ke do nuclei mein toot'ta hai, jab ke doosre reactions mein reactants aur products ki kamiyat mein kam farq hota hai; aur bohat zyada tawanai nikalti hai.

blocks.title: Fission reaction
blocks.text: Fission reaction woh hai jis mein uranium jaisa bhari nucleus taqreeban barabar size ke do nuclei mein toot'ta aur tawanai chhorta hai.

Uranium-235 ka fission 235-92-U + 1-0-n -> 141-56-Ba + 92-36-Kr + 3 1-0-n + Q (19.3) likha ja sakta hai, jahan Q nikalne wali tawanai hai. Dono taraf ki kul tawanai milane par aik uranium nucleus ke fission mein taqreeban 200 MeV nikalti hai. Mass numbers aur charge numbers ke jor dono taraf barabar hain (Fig 19.2).

Fig 19.1 ka graph ise samjhata hai. Uranium ki binding energy fi nucleon taqreeban 7.6 MeV aur fission products barium aur krypton ki taqreeban 8.5 MeV hai. Is liye jab uranium nucleus barium aur krypton mein toot'ta hai to taqreeban 8.5 - 7.6 = 0.9 MeV fi nucleon tawanai nikalti hai: 235 x 0.9 = 211.5 MeV fi uranium nucleus. Uranium ka fission hamesha aik jaise tukre nahi deta; curve ke chapte oopri hisse ke bohat se jore ban sakte hain, maslan 235-92-U + 1-0-n -> 132-50-Sn + 101-42-Mo + 3 1-0-n + Q (19.4), ya 140-54-Xe + 94-38-Sr + 2 1-0-n + Q (19.5). Fission ke tamam tukre radioactive hain. Fission doosre bhari anasir mein bhi hota hai, lekin uranium-235 aur plutonium-239 mein dheeme neutrons se bohat aasani se hota hai, aur zyada tar yahi fission ke liye use hote hain.

blocks.alt: Dheema neutron protons aur neutrons ke guchhe ki shakal mein bane uranium-235 nucleus ki taraf aata; nucleus use jazb kar ke ghair-mustahkam compound nucleus uranium-236 banta, jo barium-141 aur krypton-92 mein toot'ta; teen neutrons nikalte aur taqreeban 200 MeV tawanai. Neeche: 235-92-U + 1-0-n -> 141-56-Ba + 92-36-Kr + 3 1-0-n + Q.
blocks.caption: Uranium-235 ka fission (Fig 19.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Dono tukre uranium nucleus se zyada mazbooti se bandhe hain, is liye un ki kul kamiyat thori kam hai; yahi ghaib kamiyat taqreeban 200 MeV tawanai ban jati hai, zyada tar tukron ki kinetic energy ki shakal mein.

blocks.text: Fission mein uranium-235 nucleus aik neutron jazb kar ke taqreeban barabar kamiyat ke do nuclei mein toot'ta aur do ya teen neutrons chhorta hai. Agar yeh neutrons munasib tor par istemal hon to yeh mazeed uranium nuclei mein fission karte hain, aur reaction khud ko jari rakhta hai. Yeh fission chain reaction hai (Fig 19.3). Farz karein aik dheema neutron aik uranium atom mein fission karta aur taqreeban teen neutrons chhorta hai; halaat munasib hon to yeh mazeed atoms mein fission karte, aur bohat kam waqt mein bohat zyada tawanai, bare dhamake ke saath, paida hoti hai.

Halaat aise banaye ja sakte hain ke har fission ka sirf aik neutron agla fission kare, jab ke baqi bahar nikal jayein ya doosre maddon mein jazb ho jayein; phir chain reaction barabar raftar se chalta hai. Uranium-235 jaise fissile maddah ki patli chadar mein (Fig 19.4 a) neutrons hawa mein nikal jate aur chain reaction nahi hota. Kuch shaklein behtar halaat deti hain (Fig 19.4 b): chand neutrons aik aur fission karte, lekin phir bhi chain reaction nahi. Kafi bare gole mein (Fig 19.4 c) zyada tar neutrons nikalne se pehle jazb ho jate aur chain reaction hota hai.

blocks.title: Critical mass
blocks.text: Critical mass uranium ki woh kamiyat hai jis mein aik fission se nikalne wale tamam neutrons mein se aik neutron agla fission karta hai. Is ka hajm critical volume ya size hai.

Agar uranium ki kamiyat critical mass se kaheen zyada ho to chain reaction tezi se chalta aur bara dhamaka hota hai; atom bomb isi usool par kaam karta hai. Agar kamiyat critical mass se kam ho to chain reaction nahi chalta. Agar critical mass ke barabar ho to chain reaction barabar raftar se chalta aur tawanai ka mustaqil zariya banta hai; yeh nuclear reactor ka usool hai. Reactor mein chain reaction aam taur par cadmium ki salakhon (rods) se qaboo hota hai jo reactor mein dali jati hain. Cadmium ghair-mustahkam ya radioactive hue baghair bohat se neutrons jazb karta hai, is liye salakhein dalne se fission ke liye dastyab neutrons kam ho jate hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: shaakhon wala darakht; baen aik nucleus do neutrons do nuclei ko bhejta, har aik do aur, waghera, har qadam par fission dugne. Neeche: teen panels; patli chadar jis se neutrons nikal jate; mehrab-numa tukra jis mein aik neutron aik aur fission karta lekin baqi nikal jate; bara narangi gola (critical) jis mein kai fission ke neutrons andar jazb ho kar mazeed fission karte.
blocks.caption: Fission chain reaction aur critical mass (Figs 19.3 aur 19.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chain barhti, barabar rehti ya khatam hoti hai yeh is par munhasir hai ke har fission ke kitne neutrons agla fission karte hain. Chhota ya patla tukra apni satah se bohat neutrons kho deta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Qaboo shuda chain reaction mein har fission ka ausatan sirf aik neutron doosre nucleus ka fission karta hai. Nateejatan tawanai mustaqil, qaboo shuda raftar se nikalti hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 g uranium-235 ke mukammal fission mein, 200 MeV fi fission par, kitni tawanai nikalti hai?
blocks.explanation: Nuclei ki tadaad = (1/235) x 6.02 x 10^23 = 2.56 x 10^21; tawanai = 2.56 x 10^21 x 200 MeV x 1.6 x 10^-13 J/MeV = 8.2 x 10^10 J. (1 g koyla jalane se sirf taqreeban 3 x 10^4 J milti hai, taqreeban teen million guna kam.)
